label: preparing
what: A confidential jubilee/surprise for the mayor honoring forty years of service, with a community supper/feast in the great hall: 200 loaves and eight lanterns prepared and delivered. Baker knowingly helped with bread/oven and the final 44-loaf trade; secretary knowingly facilitated the discreet scheduled escort/appointment. The mayor was not told the real purpose before the preparations were underway, although details were later partly apparent.
